rule: Block drop table, drop column, data loss, and unreviewed object removal in release preview.
enforcement_point: sqlpackage deploy report and script review
rollback_boundary: restore point or backup boundary only

rule: Compare deployed database to the committed dacpac before publish.
failure_action: stop release until drift is classified

rule: Reference data deployments must be idempotent and natural-key based.
rollback_boundary: manual data repair script if partial execution occurs

rule: Security changes require explicit role/grant traceability.
Production publish requires main branch, approved environment, release evidence, and no failed gates.
One dacpac release is the rollback unit; data migrations use separate reviewed scripts.
rollback_boundary: roll forward preferred after schema publish

rule: External model, provider, endpoint, deployment, or model version changes require SQL AI review.
enforcement_point: SQL AI release evidence and CODEOWNERS review
rollback_boundary: revert external model definition or disable invocation

rule: Vector column dimensions, embedding model dimensions, and vector index dimensions must match.
enforcement_point: SQL AI validation and schema review
rollback_boundary: re-embed chunks and rebuild vector index after approval

rule: AI roles must not gain broad ownership, unrestricted chunk access, or cross-account retrieval.
Retrieval changes must preserve shipment/account/sensitivity/lifecycle authorization filters.
enforcement_point: SQL AI validation and static review

rule: Outbound endpoint URL and REST invocation changes require managed-identity and approved endpoint review.
enforcement_point: deployment safety rules and environment approval
